hero.headline:
Ethical Sourcing,
Made Simple.
hero.description: We connect purpose-led brands with textile manufacturers in India who are already certified, audited, and doing the work — renewable energy, fair labor, low-waste production.

intro.imageAlt: A certification shield with a copyright mark in front of a globe, leaves and garment pattern sketches
intro.text:
79° East is a sourcing bridge between global retailers and India’s reliable sustainable makers. With headquarters in North America and a dedicated team in India, we connect forward-thinking brands directly with vetted weavers, artisans, and production partners who actually walk the talk. Fair wages, transparent supply chains, and world-class textiles and decor.

You bring the vision; we handle the ground work.

values.heading: Why 79° East
values.intro: 79° East brings together the richness of Indian textile heritage and the rigor of North American business standards. We build on three non-negotiables: ethical practices, responsible sourcing, and radical transparency. By respecting the people behind the work and making deliberate choices, we create lasting value without compromise.

items.title: Two-Office Execution
items.body: With our head office in North America and an operations team in India, you work directly with a local point of contact in your time zone while our on-site team oversees production and quality checks at the source.

items.title: Verified Labor & Compliance
items.body: Every partner in our network holds active, independent third-party audits verifying fair wages, safe working conditions, and compliant labor practices.

items.title: Resource-Efficient Production
items.body: Our partner facilities utilize renewable energy, certified organic fibers, and closed-loop water systems to minimize waste and keep resources in circulation.

items.title: Transparent Economics
items.body: We work on a pre-agreed fee structure with a strict zero-kickback policy. You know exactly how we are compensated, and every supplier match is based solely on technical capability, compliance, and cost.

values.closingText: Different perspectives. Shared values. Better partnerships.

ledger.heading: Supplier Compliance & Vetting Ledger
ledger.intro:
Every well-made product is the result of deliberate decisions: how raw materials are sourced, who makes the goods, how resources are used, what technology powers the floor, and how intellectual property is protected.

At 79° East, we treat those decisions as non-negotiable. We work only with production partners who meet our benchmarks for responsible production, technical capability, and commercial integrity.

Here’s what that means in practice.

rows.particulars: We partner with facilities running on renewable energy, low-impact equipment, and closed-loop water systems—cutting carbon and resource waste at the source.
Every fiber is accounted for. Our partners source certified organic, recycled, and responsibly grown materials, giving you documented chain-of-custody from raw input to finished cloth.
rows.benchmark: Certified by global standards such as GOTS, GRS, BCI and OEKO-TEX.

rows.particulars: Fair wages, safe conditions, and genuine worker dignity are baseline requirements for every partner in our network.
Digital design, 3D sampling, low-water dye tech, and data-led production improves precision, and shorten development cycles.
Through vertically integrated facilities and tightly coordinated supply chains, our partners maintain end-to-end production oversight, verified traceability, and optimized resource use.
rows.benchmark: Mapped production tiers, and Facility audits

rows.particulars: Strict NDAs, restricted sample rooms, and enforceable IP protections safeguard your patterns, specs, and proprietary designs from first tech pack to final shipment.

ledger.closing: Good intentions don’t pass customs. Standards do.

howItWorks.heading: From Spec Sheet to Port
howItWorks.intro: A six-stage process designed to take your product from initial brief to final shipment.
howItWorks.imageAlt: Serpentine collage of a stepwell, brass and ceramic wares, a textile mill and a container ship

steps.label: Stage 01
steps.title: The Sourcing Brief
steps.body: No-pressure discovery. We meet on your time zone to establish your technical specs, target margins, MOQs, and compliance requirements before contacting any facility.

steps.label: Stage 02
steps.title: Partner Matchmaking
steps.body: Right maker, right scale. We match your brief to vetted manufacturer or supplier in India built for your exact volume and design needs.

steps.label: Stage 03
steps.title: Sampling & Sign-Off
steps.body: Sample Verification. You review pre-production samples in hand to confirm fabric weight, dye accuracy, and stitching before approving full production.

steps.label: Stage 04
steps.title: Tracked Production
steps.body: Milestone reporting. You receive documented updates at each production phase, from yarn sourcing through final finishing. Helping keep schedules visible and accountable.

steps.label: Stage 05
steps.title: Quality Control
steps.body: Pre-shipment verification. Our ground team inspects finished goods against your spec sheet prior to packing. Upon prior agreement, we also coordinate accredited third-party compliance audits on your behalf.

steps.label: Stage 06
steps.title: Export & Delivery
steps.body: Logistics oversight. We coordinate dispatch timelines, export paperwork, and carrier handoffs between the facility and your logistics team.

howItWorks.policyText: You receive the original factory quote alongside our exact commission terms upfront. Under our strict zero-kickback policy, supplier selection is determined solely by technical capability, verified compliance, and fit.
